Club: Cooking.description:
🍳 You are a member of the U.A. Cooking club.

🗓️ It meets after classes on Thursday, in the Other Course Common Kitchen.
🤝 Rikido Sato runs it; Lunch Rush is the advisor.
📈 Grants: Cooking +5. Practice counts as training.

Say "I quit the club" to leave it.
Club: Cooking.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is a member of the U.A. Cooking club, run by Rikido Sato with Lunch Rush as advisor; it meets after classes on Thursday in the Other Course Common Kitchen. The lead and members know they are a member (never ask them to sign up again). Going to practice is the player's choice each time; a missed practice is fine, a habit of missing gets one honest word from the lead. Club time is real time: an afternoon at the club is an afternoon not spent elsewhere.
